 Soaking rain on the way
 Plan for off & on rain tonight, Sunday, and Monday
 Shelby Ebertowski , KSAT Weather Authority Meteorologist 
 Adam Caskey , KSAT Weather Authority Meteorologist
 Published:  November 7, 2026 at 11:08 PM Tags:  Forecast FORECAST HIGHLIGHTS 
 OVERNIGHT: Rain gradually becomes widespread 
 SUNDAY: Off & on rain 
 MONDAY: Off & on rain 
 FLASH FLOOD RISK: Low (but not 0%) 
 RAINFALL TOTALS : Widespread 1–3 inches through Monday, with isolated totals up to 5 inches. IMPACTS: Ponding on roads, and localized street flooding possible, especially in urban and low-lying areas. 
 FORECAST 
 RAIN SLOWLY DEVELOPS 
 It’s a gradual process with the rain slowly becoming widespread overnight. So far most of the rain has been just west and north of Bexar County, but that changes tonight. 
 SUNDAY & MONDAY: RAINY & COOL 
 Intermittent, widespread rain with a temperature near 60°. It won’t rain continuously all day at your house, so plan for the rain to come and go throughout the day, but at times, it’ll pick up and be heavy.
 RAINFALL TOTALS THROUGH MONDAY 
 It’s likely we’ll see widespread totals of 1–3 inches, with some spots potentially seeing up to 5 inches. Unlike the intense downpours we typically see in the spring and summer, this rain will be spread out over several days, which should keep the risk of flooding low.
 Widespread 1"-3" likely with localized amounts of 5" or more possible over the span of a few days. (Copyright KSAT-12 2026 - All Rights Reserved) RAIN CONTINUES INTO NEXT WEEK 
 The sun slowly returns by midweek with temperatures climbing back into the lower 70s.
